gravedigger.summary: The model is the old gravedigger with a flat cap, a gray beard, a green scarf, a lantern, and a spade. It matches the mockup with small differences in coat value, cap size, and mouth.
strengths: The gray beard, the pink nose, and the bushy brows match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The lantern and the spade are in the correct hands and read in every sprite direction.
The green scarf, the brown sleeve patches, the belt, and the brown boots follow the mockup.
issues: The coat is a light, clean gray. The mockup coat is a dark, weathered gray-brown. Make the coat darker and add wear to it.
The flat cap is too large and too puffy for the head. Make the cap smaller and flatter, as in the mockup.
The beard hides the mouth, so the gentle smile of the mockup does not show. Add a small smile line under the mustache.
The lantern glass is pale. The mockup lantern has a warm yellow glow. Make the lantern glass brighter and warmer.
In walk, the body and the arms move very little. This is a known base limit.
gravedigger.next: Make the coat a darker, weathered gray-brown so that the value plan and the mood match the mockup.

jeweler.summary: The model is the jeweler with a gold monocle, a purple vest, a magnifier with a blue gem, and a red ring box. The props match the mockup, but the mouth and the hair are different.
strengths: The gold monocle, the magnifier with the blue gem, and the red ring box match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The purple vest with the gold chains, the white shirt, the gold buckle, and the black shoes follow the mockup palette.
The props are in the correct hands and the curled mustache matches the mockup.
issues: The mouth is open and red, with white pointed teeth. It reads as a fanged grin. The mockup has a closed, friendly smile. Change the mouth to a closed smile under the mustache.
The hair is a tall block with deep ridges. It reads as a knit cap or a helmet in every view and in the sprites. Make the hair lower and smoother, swept back, as in the mockup.
The beard comes to a point under the chin. The mockup beard is short and full along the jaw. Make the beard shorter and rounder.
In walk, the arms stay still. This is a known base limit.
jeweler.next: Change the mouth to a closed, friendly smile under the mustache.

lumberjack.summary: The model is the lumberjack with a knit cap, a brown beard, a red plaid shirt, suspenders, and an axe across the shoulders. It is very close to the mockup.
strengths: The pose matches the mockup: the fists rest on the hips and the axe lies across the shoulders behind the neck.
The red and black plaid, the brown suspenders, the gray knit cap, and the brown beard match the mockup palette.
The axe, the cap, and the red shirt read in every sprite direction.
issues: The body is less broad than the burly mockup. Make the chest and the shoulders wider to show the big, strong build.
The mouth is wide open. The mockup smile shows less of the mouth. Close the mouth a little.
The belt buckle is silver. The mockup buckle is brass. Change the buckle color to brass.
In walk, the arms stay on the hips and the body moves little.
lumberjack.next: Make the chest and the shoulders wider so that the big, strong build of the mockup reads.

mason.summary: The model is the young mason with a tan flat cap, curly ginger hair, freckles, an apron, a stone block, and a trowel. It is the same character, but the smile and the trowel are weaker than in the mockup.
strengths: The tan flat cap, the freckles, the tan apron with brown straps, and the gray boots match the mockup.
The stone block has a rough stone surface and reads at 128 px.
The cap and the apron make the role clear in every sprite direction.
issues: The mouth is a small, calm smile. The mockup has a wide, cheerful smile. Make the smile wider and lift the corners of the mouth.
The trowel is a small blade that the fist almost hides. Make the trowel blade larger and show the handle, as in the mockup.
The shirt is a bright sky blue with no collar. The mockup shirt is a muted blue-gray with a collar and rolled sleeves. Make the shirt color less saturated and add a collar.
The hair curls are separate round lumps in a band under the cap. Blend the curls into a softer mass.
At the back, the shirt hangs below the apron belt like a long skirt. Shorten the shirt at the back.
In walk, the arms stay still. This is a known base limit.
mason.next: Make the smile wider so that the cheerful expression of the mockup reads.

magistrate.summary: The model is the magistrate with a white curled wig, round black glasses, a black robe, a white collar band, a gavel, and a law book. It is very close to the mockup.
strengths: The white curled wig, the round black glasses, and the orange brows match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The black robe, the red vest, the red collar, and the white collar band follow the mockup palette.
The gavel and the law book are in the correct hands.
issues: The white collar band is a small lump. The mockup band has layered folds that hang down the chest. Make the collar band longer, with folds.
The gavel is small and hard to see beside the robe. Make the gavel head larger.
The robe is glossy black. The mockup robe is a matte dark gray with wide lapels. Make the robe less glossy and add lapels.
The wig is narrower at the sides than in the mockup. Add curls at the sides of the wig.
In walk, the arms stay still and the body moves little. This is a known base limit.
magistrate.next: Make the collar band longer, with layered folds, as in the mockup.
